description: ONE named instrument, in full. Returns the Martingale Score (0-5), the current Startingale reading, the score breakdown, the sequence structure (spacing, rounds, quantity multipliers) and exchange availability for a single crypto or US stock. Use this when you already know the symbol; use search_instruments to find symbols. Answers in formatted text, not JSON. Costs 1 unit of the monthly quota: the cheapest call, so walking a handful of known symbols one by one is fine.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, not a name: BTC (not Bitcoin), ETH, SOL for crypto; AAPL, NVDA, MELI for US stocks. Case-insensitive. Use search_instruments if you only know the name.

type.description: Which catalogue to answer from: crypto or stock. Optional. Without it, both are searched; if the symbol exists in both (some tickers are a coin and a US stock), the answer lists both and asks you to call again with a type. With it, that catalogue answers, and the other is tried only if the symbol is not found.

name: get_instrument
